newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fall in prices gradually coming to halt, BOJ says.
newsitem.headline: Fall in prices gradually coming to halt, BOJ says.

text.p: The drop in Japan's domestic wholesale prices appears to be coming to a halt gradually, a Bank of Japan official said on Monday.
The BOJ earlier announced that domestic wholesale prices in August were unchanged from July, but were down 0.7 percent from a year earlier.
"It appears that the fall in domestic prices is gradually coming to a halt," the official said.
In year-on-year terms, domestic wholesale prices had been falling by more than one percent until June.
In August, wholesale prices in steel and in oil products rose month on month while prices for electrical appliances fell.
